page: Hetzner Cloud ccx53 is a dedicated CPU virtual server built on the x86_64 architecture using the QEMU hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical AMD EPYC cores with multithreading enabled, running at a base clock speed of 2.0 GHz. The processor includes 32 KB of L1d cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. The system is provisioned with 125.0 GB of RAM, yielding approximately 3.91 GB of memory per core, and is bundled with 600 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

In benchmark evaluations, the ccx53 demonstrates solid performance characteristics. Its single-core CPU performance via stress-ng is strong, placing in the top 25%, while multi-core performance remains in the average tier. Cryptographic capabilities are notable, with the PassMark CPU encryption test scoring in the top 25%, aided by hardware-accelerated AES and SHA instruction sets. Memory performance is a key highlight; the PassMark memory score reaches the top tier, although raw sequential memory bandwidth tests for both read and write operations fall within the average range. For specialized workloads, the server achieves top-tier text generation speeds of 353.73 tokens per second when running a small 135M parameter LLM.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ccx53 offers a balanced resource density, combining dedicated AMD EPYC compute resources with a high-capacity memory profile and fast NVMe storage without the overhead of specialized GPU hardware. This configuration is well-suited for general-purpose enterprise workloads, multi-threaded decompression tasks, software compilation, static web serving, and moderate database operations.
description: Hetzner Cloud ccx53 is a dedicated CPU virtual server featuring 32 vCPUs and 16 physical AMD EPYC cores on the x86_64 architecture. Operating under the QEMU hypervisor, it delivers 125.0 GB of RAM and 600 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, with no integrated GPU. The server exhibits strong single-core CPU performance and top-tier memory performance, as evidenced by its PassMark memory score. It also excels in specific tasks, achieving top-tier text generation speeds for small language models and strong multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. With its balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated compute allocation, the ccx53 provides a highly capable environment for general-purpose enterprise applications, software compilation, web serving, and database workloads requiring reliable, non-shared CPU resources.
